assets.caption: Table A.3 Shape Coefficients for x, y, and z Planes and the Summation Coefficients

issues: asset_note: Landscape-oriented table occupying nearly the entire page. Dense matrix tabulating shape coefficients across x y and x z planes with summation rows (Σ) and columns including moment terms (M_x, M_y, M_z), force terms (F_x, F_y, F_z), combined torsion/force ratio terms (M_xT+M_yT)/(r_x r_y) etc., F_xT/r_x^2 etc., s_1, s_2, and a -Constant column. Symbols include +, ++, 0, Δ, Σ, Φ with x/y/z subscripts, and B/C prefixed variants in lower blocks.
